svg.text: People and external systems around the OzAgriMate Platform | dashed = proposed extension outside the core prototype
Interaction; arrow shows direction of the main data flow
Carbon verification, drone micro-dosing and trade execution are bounded extensions from Assignment 2; they are not part of the eight-endpoint prototype.
Field equipment connects through the Farm Edge Gateway shown in the container view; ISOBUS, ADAPT, LoRaWAN and NB-IoT are adapted there.
